io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.commands

Class SubCommand

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.commands.SubCommand
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    DebugCommand

    public abstract class SubCommand
extends java.lang.Object
    This class represents a SubCommand, it is a Command that starts with /sf ... and is followed by the name of this SubCommand.
